description: The parsed hostname length does not exceed the complete URL length.
explanation: The hostname is a substring/component of the complete URL.

description: The longest raw URL token is at least the average raw token length.
explanation: A maximum of a collection cannot be below its arithmetic mean.

description: The average raw URL token length is at least the shortest raw token length.
explanation: An arithmetic mean cannot be below the minimum of the same nonempty token collection.

description: The longest host token is at least the average host token length.
explanation: A maximum of the host-token collection cannot be below its arithmetic mean.

description: The average host token length is at least the shortest host token length.
explanation: An arithmetic mean cannot be below the minimum of the same nonempty host-token collection.

description: The longest path token is at least the average path token length.
explanation: When path tokens exist, a maximum cannot be below their arithmetic mean; when absent, both path quantities are zero by definition.

description: The average path token length is at least the shortest path token length.
explanation: For a nonempty path-token collection the mean is at least its minimum, and when absent both values are zero by definition.

description: The hostname character length is at least the longest host token length.
explanation: The longest host token is contained within the parsed hostname, whose length includes token characters and separators.

description: The complete URL length is at least the longest raw token length.
explanation: Every raw URL token is composed of characters occurring within the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the longest path token length.
explanation: Every path token is a character substring/component of the complete URL.

description: The extracted hyperlink/resource count is at least the number of external CSS links.
explanation: External CSS links are a subset of linked resources extracted from href and src attributes.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of period characters.
explanation: Each counted period is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of hyphen characters.
explanation: Each counted hyphen is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of ampersand characters.
explanation: Each counted ampersand is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of equals-sign characters.
explanation: Each counted equals sign is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of underscore characters.
explanation: Each counted underscore is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of percent-sign characters.
explanation: Each counted percent sign is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of forward-slash characters.
explanation: Each counted forward slash is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least its number of semicolon characters.
explanation: Each counted semicolon is one character in the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length covers the total count of the listed URL punctuation characters.
formula: length_url - nb_dots - nb_hyphens - nb_and - nb_eq - nb_underscore - nb_percent - nb_slash - nb_semicolumn >= 0
explanation: Periods, hyphens, ampersands, equals signs, underscores, percent signs, slashes, and semicolons are distinct character categories, each counted within the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of nonempty raw URL tokens.
explanation: The nonempty raw tokens are disjoint character components of the URL, and each contains at least one character.

description: The complete URL length is at least the shortest nonempty raw URL token length.
explanation: Every raw URL token is a component of the complete URL, including the shortest token when the raw-token collection is nonempty.

description: The parsed hostname length is at least the shortest host token length.
explanation: The shortest nonempty host token is contained in the parsed hostname, whose total character length includes that token.

description: The complete URL length covers the parsed hostname together with all forward slashes in the URL.
explanation: The hostname characters and forward-slash characters are disjoint character positions within the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length covers the parsed hostname together with ampersands and equals signs.
explanation: Ampersands and equals signs cannot be hostname characters, so their counted positions are additional to the hostname characters within the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length covers the parsed hostname together with percent signs and semicolons.
explanation: Percent signs and semicolons are not hostname characters, so these counted URL characters are additional to the parsed hostname.

description: The longest raw URL token is at least the average host token length.
explanation: The raw-token maximum is at least the host-token maximum, which is at least the host-token arithmetic mean.

description: The longest raw URL token is at least the average path token length.
explanation: The raw-token maximum is at least the path-token maximum, which is at least the path-token arithmetic mean; absent path tokens have zero average.

description: The sum of hostname length and URL dot count is nonnegative.
explanation: Both columns are counts: hostname character length and number of period characters in the complete URL. Counts cannot be negative, so their sum is universally nonnegative; the prior containment claim is invalid because URL dots may occur outside the hostname.
